name: Heritage
source: After the festivities of you and your twin sister Emma's 18th birthday party, your mother sits you all down and reads you an important letter from your late father. The contents of the letter will forever alter your family dynamic. You learn that you have a...unique Heritage™ (heh). Be warned, though, as others might be out to capitalize on it.
translation: 在你和你的双胞胎妹妹艾玛 (Emma) 的18岁生日派对庆祝结束后，你的母亲让你们坐下，给你们读了一封来自已故父亲的重要信。这封信的内容将永远改变你的家庭动态。你了解到你拥有…独特的Heritage™（呵呵）。但请注意，其他人可能会利用它。
